workspace.name: UnityIndie RPG MMO
workspace.note: The workspace root is NOT a git repo. Each repo below is independent.

tiers.fast: Always required for every touched module and every module that depends on it. Cheap, local, deterministic.
tiers.extended: Required when a trigger applies, but expensive or environment-sensitive. Ask the user before running; otherwise report NOT RUN (needs confirmation).
tiers.external: Runs outside this shell (Unity Editor, CI, Docker stack, remote). Ask, or report NOT RUN (external) with the reason.

go.note: go.mod requires go 1.26.x; GOTOOLCHAIN=auto downloads/uses the cached toolchain, so a lower local go is fine unless GOTOOLCHAIN=local.

dotnet.note: WSL usually has only the Windows dotnet.exe. Substitute {dotnet} with the resolved binary.

protoc.note: CI pins protoc 29.3 + protoc-gen-go v1.36.6. Regenerating with another version drifts the committed headers and fails the proto-generated CI job.

unity-mcp.purpose: Unity Editor MCP (ai-game-developer). Reachable only while the Editor has the client project open. Used to run the Unity Test Runner from an agent.

global_rules.rule: All code, comments, docs, changelogs and commit messages in English.
Current phase is core plumbing only - no gameplay content. If a task would require inventing a gameplay rule (numbers, formulas, content), STOP and ask the user.
Every change adds an entry under '## [Unreleased]' (Keep a Changelog: Added/Changed/Fixed/Removed/Deprecated/Security) in the CHANGELOG of every touched module.
Update the module docs (README/API/DESIGN/RUNBOOK) before reporting done. New public function or RPC -> API.md entry. Architecture change -> dated DESIGN.md note.
rpg-mmo-server/backend/docs/ARCHITECTURE-DECISIONS.md is authoritative; older docs may be stale. Read the relevant ADR before changing an architectural boundary.
Cross-language contracts change on both sides in the same commit: wire.proto (Go + C# bindings) and the Redis hash servers:id:{id} (C# RedisServerRegistry.cs <-> Go redisstore/registry.go).

A result is evidence only after it passes the verify-a-result checklist: count passes (never infer from absence of failures), prove a zero can be non-zero, name the object measured, write the expected value before measuring.

Agents never create or push tags in ANY workspace repo (v*, sgl-v*, core-baseline-*). Tags are release actions of the lead. Skills stop at 'ready to tag <repo> <tag>' with evidence; the git guard denies tag creation and tag pushes.
Factory never creates feature registries, GDD state or task trackers (.ai/, docs/registry/, docs/features/) - that lifecycle belongs to the game-ai-workflows plugin.

modules.responsibility: Wire protocol source of truth (wire.proto) and its generator.
rules: wire.proto is the only source; never hand-edit generated bindings.
Frames: 4-byte big-endian length prefix + Protobuf; legacy JSON still accepted, told apart by first byte (ADR-9). Fields snake_case.
A wire change updates Go and C# in the same commit and must be proven by the cross-language integration suite.

extended.evidence: Generated diff matches the intended proto change and nothing else. Requires protoc 29.3 + protoc-gen-go v1.36.6 (CI pin); any other version drifts version headers.

Systems implement IEcsSystem with Group, unique Order and complete ComponentAccess (structural if spawn/reap); no mutable instance fields except [SimulationScratch] (SimulationStateArchitectureTests).
New component type -> World/ArchAotHints.cs line in the same commit (ArchAotHintTests). No CommandBuffer (ADR-11/12).

known_issues.summary: backend/TEAM.md points to a verify-a-result skill in .claude/skills/ of the server repo; it exists only in the client repo (and .claude/ is gitignored in the server repo). Factory Core points to the client copy.

ci-dotnet.yml comments and backend/deploy/docs/CICD.md 'Known gap: wire-compat coverage' say the cross-language E2E suite runs only in cd.yml on push. ci.yml's test-integration job runs it on every PR (verified: PR run 36089393362, 25 PASS incl. TestDotnetInterop_FullFlow). The docs are stale; trust the workflow + run log.
Workspace-root toggle-packages.sh rewrites Packages/manifest.json but not packages-lock.json and writes WSL file: paths. Never commit its output; 02-package-pins would fail.
CI pins protoc 29.3 + protoc-gen-go v1.36.6; the local WSL protoc may differ (factory-context reports it). Regenerating with a different version drifts headers.
WSL has no Linux dotnet; only Windows dotnet.exe. Build/test work through it; Linux AOT publish and env-var passing (GOLDEN_REGEN) need care (WSLENV).
Documentation~/NETCODE.md (~line 359) says nothing in CI diffs Wire.cs; ci.yml job 'wire' does (against server develop, unpinned).

Netcode CI (ci.yml:225,323,504) and UnityDots CI (ci.yml:173,325,693) bootstrap sgl-v0.5.0 while the client pins sgl-v0.6.0 - package CI tests against an older SGL than the client ships. UIToolkit CI has no SGL pin. UnityDots CI rows also pin Netcode v0.41.0 (client pins v0.45.0).
.claude/agents/unity-netcode.md predates the package split (code now in com.cuvara.netcode), references a non-existent unity-prediction agent and /mnt/e paths.
Gitignored Packages/com.cuvara.* clones in the client are old (netcode v0.30.0-3, dots v0.27.1-1) and override the manifest pins in the Editor; Tools/WireConformance compiles against them.
Netcode has no .gitignore; building the headless tests in place leaves bin/obj untracked. Factory runs them from a temp copy (scripts/checks/netcode-headless.sh).
No workflow runs validate-manifests.py, kubeconform, promtool or compose config; deploy manifests are validated only locally before cd.yml applies them.
CHANGELOG '## [0.30.0]' undated and package.json 0.30.0 while the last tag is v0.29.0.
CHANGELOG.md is not valid UTF-8.
UnityDots tracks .github/scripts/__pycache__/*.pyc; running its scripts without PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 rewrites tracked files. Factory commands set it.
validate-manifests.py k8s/app/*.yaml reports 2 failures at 5023a3d: expects namespace rpg-realtime, k8s/app uses rpg-k8s-realtime (overridden via ALLOCATOR_NAMESPACE in 40-gateway.yaml).
backend/deploy/modules/nakama.so is gitignored (not committed); the local copy may be stale - stack.sh up rebuilds it when older than the sources.

MONITORING.md misses alerts.yaml; cd.yml bundle file list omits monitoring/alerts.yaml and does not copy docker-compose.override.yml; stack.sh says no flow-check-sealed but Makefile:101 defines it; deploy CLAUDE.md 'File Structure Target' differs from the tree.
backend/gateway/CLAUDE.md says the gateway calls Nakama at runtime NONE; transfer/party.go calls party_get (ADR-26).

Client CLAUDE.md: SampleImporter example uses -importPackage (code needs -samplePackage) and E:\SecretProject paths; Unity MCP section describes Docker :8080 (real: .mcp.json HTTP :23621); Assembly Structure lists 3 of 13 asmdefs. Workspace CLAUDE.md 'gh workflow run unity-build.yml' names a removed workflow.
docs/DOTS-WIRING.md still describes the primitive view fallback as the deliberate default; LeasedViewAssetProvider over Addressables is now the default.

BENCHMARK.md/loadtest README say restart the server before each load level; the 2026-09-18 control used -cooldown 40s. BENCHMARK.md reads secrets from deploy/.env (a secrets gate) - export them instead.
Root and gameserver-dotnet CLAUDE.md show `--addr=:9000`; GetArg only matches the space-separated form, so the `=` form is silently ignored.
gameserver-dotnet/CLAUDE.md describes the wire as 4-byte BE + JSON; ADR-9 moved it to Protobuf (JSON still accepted).

check_metas.py reads git ls-files (untracked files invisible) and skips ~ folders; UnityDots Samples~ has 8 and UIToolkit Samples~ 17 files without .meta.

human_gates.rule: Creating, deleting or pushing tags in any repo - the lead only. The guard denies it.
git push, opening/merging PRs, GitHub releases - only when the user explicitly asks in this task.
Dispatching CI/CD or release workflows (cd.yml, publish-images, client 10/11/20-24 builds, package version-bump) - explicit user authorization.
kubectl/helm against any cluster, ssh/scp to a VPS, applying manifests, anything touching staging or production - explicit user authorization; never automatic.
Never read, print or commit backend/deploy/kubeconfig.local, .env files, secret manifests with values, or credentials.

Pointing the client at local package clones (toggle-packages.sh dev) edits the user's client tree: only with explicit consent; back up Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json first and restore them byte-identical (cmp) afterwards - never 'restore' with toggle-packages.sh release (it pins each package to its newest local tag, not the previous pin); never commit its output.
Starting/stopping/resetting the local Docker stack (make up/flow-up/reset/down, stack.sh up/down, docker compose up/down) - heavy and stateful; ask first. Health checks (make flow-check) are fine.
Inventing gameplay rules/numbers/content is out of phase (plumbing only) - stop and ask.
Running database/Redis backup or restore scripts - explicit user authorization.
Load generation (bench.sh, encoding-sweep.sh, the loadtest binary) against any stack - ask first; never against staging/production without authorization.
Launching or verifying multiple Unity players on the user's machine.
Unity batch-mode builds/imports (PlayerBuilder, SampleImporter, StrippingProbeBuilder, AddressableBuilder) change project state; ask first.
Running the migrator standalone or writing schema_migrations by hand.
Scene/prefab/asset edits through Unity MCP tools need an explicit yes (the Editor state is the user's).
Only the lead releases Shared.GameLogic: package.json version bump for release, sgl-v* tags, dispatching publish-shared-gamelogic.yml. Skills stop at 'ready to tag server sgl-vX.Y.Z'.
